evaluation: Grade each case with and without the skill in isolated fixtures; never use live cluster writes or real secrets.

evals.name: document-service
evals.expected_output: Searches existing docs and 00-index first; reads actual manifest and source. Adds a new numbered doc only if absent (never 05), with coverage/date and index row, then clean claims table.

evals.name: minimal-ci-update
evals.prompt: update the CI doc, the registry moved to Zot auth
evals.expected_output: Reads current source and 15-cicd.md; edits only affected sections, flags discrepancy, runs claims checker, preserves untouched sections.

evals.name: removed-names
evals.prompt: Check a doc mentioning `jwt-validator` and AFFiNE.
evals.expected_output: Checker warns on both with iap and Outline replacements; historical mentions are explicitly judged rather than automatically deleted.

evals.name: verify-existing
evals.expected_output: Verify mode reads code, manifests and playbooks; returns claim/evidence/verdict table. Fixes only after yes; states unverified runtime claims.

evals.name: explain-po
evals.expected_output: Leads with user outcome and trade-off table, cites evidence after the answer, avoids a technical code walk. Offers repo/wiki/terminal choice after substantial work, saves only on choice.

evals.name: explain-engineer
evals.expected_output: Code walk with file:line for every code reference, boundaries and failure modes, then alternatives rejected; marks unverified claims.

evals.name: ambiguous-destination
evals.expected_output: Asks wiki (why/intent/outcome) or repo (how built/run) before writing; does not guess.

evals.name: missing-path
evals.expected_output: FAIL path: missing with fix; fixes or removes the claim before delivering a draft; no missing-path claim silently retained.

evals.name: jr-boundaries
evals.prompt: (jr-se active) update docs for my task and commit them
evals.expected_output: Only task-scoped doc changes; no commit/push/ship/seal/scaffold; hands commit to sr-se.

evals.name: explain-no-role
evals.prompt: (no active role) explain how authentication works
evals.expected_output: Asks the audience in one line; no role warnings. Does not save automatically.
